study_meta.period_raw: 23 January – 13 February 2020 (case reporting); 18 January – 8 February 2020 (symptom onset)
study_meta.population_raw: First 53 laboratory-confirmed cases of COVID-19 in Hong Kong and their close contacts
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 53 confirmed cases; 26 infector–infectee paired data (probable: 9; certain: 17) for serial interval; 206 close contacts for secondary attack rate
study_meta.method_raw: Doubly interval-censored likelihood with right truncation, fitting gamma, lognormal and Weibull distributions in Bayesian framework; 95% credible intervals computed

parameter_mentions.distribution_raw: lognormal (best fit by WAIC: 214.7 vs 217.6 and 219.0 for gamma and Weibull)
